719-2493-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-2493-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-1117-6518-8346.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1849-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

240-1753-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-1753-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

765-1479-7893.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-4929-5652-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-4929-5652-7803.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
2060-4929-5652-7803.notes: Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

3532-5078-5957-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2511-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2511-4556-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1169-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1169-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2281-2921-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2783-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-3562-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2438-2932-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2438-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
2438-2932-5220-6900.notes: The creature with mana value 1 or less can be Carrion Feeder, if desired. However, you will forego putting infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

907-4572-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4572-5478-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

394-2035-4067.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
394-2035-4067.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-3908-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-3908-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double has a power of at least 2.
3719-3908-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Spark Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Spark Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Spark Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-1987-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1018-1987-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

1912-4613-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1912-4613-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2909-4050-5851.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

56-5256-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Hogaak's power.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

2511-4089-5011.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1355-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1355-4222.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may activate Sanctum Weaver an infinitely large number of times, adding infinite colored mana.

200-2178-4050-4149.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
1 other creature on the battlefield.
200-2178-4050-4149.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.

738-2034-3370-5004.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
